verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm Grok Build signs in against an xAI/SuperGrok subscription. At launch it was limited to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers, and a user on a $40/month plan couldn't get past login because access is gated on a higher tier. The first-party docs only mention a `--device-auth` sign-in flag and do not explain subscription-based sign-in or which plans qualify. Missing for 10: first-party docs on subscription sign-in and eligible plans, access for lower-tier subscribers, and hands-on confirmation of a successful subscription login.
